title: Android on-device DSH runtime
description:
Beta.4 uses the standard native Home, Pixels, workshop and chat with either Hermes or on-device DSH. Android packages pinned ARM64 PRoot/Alpine/Node/DSH; the shared adapter writes reviewed real presets, restores sessions and pending requests, streams model replies and maps companion controls. Advanced web/terminal/Stop stay under Engines. Local Pixels share a workspace; provider keys currently remain in app-private DSH storage.
Android 2.0 (7): all five ARM64 Android 16/API 36 runtime tests pass, including native preset creation, a controlled model turn through real DSH, native streaming/history, private authenticated HTTP/WebSocket access, native navigation, service Stop/restart, and workspace/edited-skill preservation. All 25 JVM tests, lint and signed release packaging pass. Native ELF and ZIP alignment meet 16 KB requirements; the emulator itself uses 4 KB pages.
Full iOS build 8 simulator acceptance passes a unique current-turn SSE reply, an explicitly unfinished turn before Home, eight seconds in the background, native completion and stored history after a full app/guest restart. The fixture has a separate app/Keychain identity; production Release omits the hook. Physical build 7 smoke proved native startup/navigation/chat UI only; build 8 physical acceptance awaits the unavailable iPhone.
Remaining: physical ARM64 Android and 16 KB pages, real-account model/image turns and actual delegation, PTYs/native host bridges, OEM/background/battery/process-death coverage, and native encrypted provider storage. https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/docs/DSH-PROVIDER.md

title: Accessibility, tablet layouts and performance
description:
Beta.4 fixes repeated local chat opens and obsolete session lookups, gates Send until the current attachment succeeds, and keeps drafts editable during setup/disconnect. The dashboard uses stronger light/dark header scrims and shared pixel icons for engine stats. Both themes were inspected on the iOS simulator and signed Android release; captures are explicitly labelled demo.
Validation passes: 28 iOS unit tests, 3 native UI tests, 25 Android JVM tests, 5 Android runtime tests, 18 DSH adapter tests, 13 Hermes watcher tests, 5 asset checks and 38 Swift PixelSpec assertions. Native builds, Android lint/runtime hashes/16 KB ELF+ZIP alignment, signed full iOS archive/export and Release fixture-hook exclusion pass. PR #6 resolved one Codex configuration finding and one Greptile background-test finding. Final Greptile review reports 32 files reviewed, no new comments.
The full iOS Debug acceptance test now matches app path and bundle identity, uses a unique reply marker, asserts an unfinished turn, and gates the final SSE chunk until eight seconds on the Home screen. Native completion and cold-launch history pass in 87.152 seconds. This is simulator evidence with a controlled endpoint, not a real-account or physical lifecycle claim. Build 7 physical smoke remains limited to startup/navigation/chat UI; build 8 awaits the unavailable iPhone.
Keep in progress for physical accessibility, VoiceOver/TalkBack, dynamic type, contrast/touch targets, reduced motion, tablet/keyboard/safe areas, large histories, battery/process death, real-account transport recovery and physical Android/16 KB testing. Website browser visual QA remains unverified after automatic browser approval was denied.
Evidence: https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/docs/evidence/ios-build8-simulator-model.json
Captures: https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/screenshots/README.md

title: Evaluate Harness2 for evidence-based Pixel improvement
description: User-linked Harness2 evaluated at google-research/harness2 commit 1cfe254e8d25b15f37048c3730134686abe60335, Apache-2.0, Python 3.12/3.13. Deterministic credential-free demo passed parallel and sequential recursion at k=2: two tasks, zero failures, 28 executions and 32 editor calls. Existing executors are OpenCode/Codex; Hermes/DSH needs a substrate adapter. Proposed next experiment: one bounded probe step per explicitly selected test task on PC/VPS, evidence-based persona/skill/delegation suggestions shown as a reviewed PixelSpec diff, versioned adoption and rollback. Keep secrets, connector authorization and enforced access outside the editable harness. Do not replay side-effecting tasks as probes. Acceptance: real Hermes adapter, independent outcome checks, budget/cancellation/reconnect/partial-failure coverage, evidence redaction and unchanged access. Not integrated or shipped as a mobile runtime. Source and plan: https://github.com/google-research/harness2 and https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/PLAN.md.
